title: The Thunder King Returns
summary: Lei Shen's ancient dominion and later return bring Zandalari forces, pandaren defenders, and both factions to the Isle of Thunder.
opening: An empire long gone from Pandaria's present still cast a shadow. When Lei Shen returned, old power entered a new war.

chapters.title: The ancient dominion
chapters.body: Introduce Lei Shen's ancient rule and its consequence for Pandaria. This is a prologue, not the date of the modern Isle of Thunder campaign.

chapters.title: The return
chapters.body: Investigate how Lei Shen's return becomes a crisis. Original quests must establish the mechanics and sequence before a finished chapter is written.

chapters.title: The Isle of Thunder
chapters.body: Follow the Zandalari, pandaren defenders, and Alliance and Horde efforts around the island while separating faction-specific quests from the shared account.

chapters.title: After the throne
chapters.body: Review the raid and campaign's outcome and ask what the end of Lei Shen's return changes for Pandaria's present.

reviewNote: Verify the resurrection, faction campaign order, and raid aftermath against released quests, scenarios, and raid text. Do not merge Lei Shen's ancient reign with his later return.
